title: Finance and Corporate Services Committee - January 05, 2026

items.title: Commencement
notes: The Finance and Corporate Services Committee held a meeting this date commencing at 4:15 p.m.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Adjournment of Development Charges Complaints - 15 Dellroy Avenue and 1438 Highland Road, FIN-2026-015
notes:
The Committee considered Financial Services Department report FIN-2026-015, dated December 17, 2025 recommending adjournment of the hearing related to the complaint of development charges at 15 Dellroy Avenue and 1438 Highland Road.

R. Hagey and K. Fischer were in attendance to respond to questions from the Committee.

The Committee was advised that Staff received an adjournment request from the appellants to allow an opportunity for further consideration of the complaints. It was noted Staff are in support of adjourning the hearing but have provided alternative recommendations in Financial Services Department reports FIN-2026-016 and FIN 2026-017 listed as items 5.1.a and 5.1.b on the agenda this date, should the Committee choose not to approve the adjournment.

items.title: Adjournment
notes:
On motion, this meeting adjourned at 4:17 p.m.

 

Marilyn Mills
Committee Coordinator

motions.item_title: Adjournment of Development Charges Complaints - 15 Dellroy Avenue and 1438 Highland Road, FIN-2026-015
motions.text: it was resolved: "That the request to adjourn the hearing related to the complaint of development charges at 15 Dellroy Avenue and 1438 Highland Road until no later than February 9, 2026, as outlined in Financial Services Department report FIN-2026-015, be granted."
